create.create_life_totals: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS life_totals (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL);

select.select_life_totals_by_user_id: SELECT total FROM life_totals WHERE user_id = ?;

update.update_life_totals_by_user_id: UPDATE life_totals SET total = ? WHERE user_id = ?;
